decisions.reason: As a recently launched automation module closely aligned with the firm’s digital-control strategy and established heat-exchanger offer, management would likely continue it because it fits prior R&D commitments and there is no clear evidence yet that weak results are more than temporary.

The web tool for weir dimensioning supports the firm’s engineering and planner-oriented business, likely required limited incremental investment, and would be kept as a strategically coherent digital complement while its market uptake is still developing.

Because this fouling detection system builds directly on the firm’s existing water and energy infrastructure capabilities and embodies visible recent development effort, management would be inclined to persist with it rather than withdraw after only a short time on the market.
